title: client: `meta.deleteItem` cannot name a package — after #23165 a delete of a name two packages hold answers 409, and the SDK has no way to pass the `?package=` remedy
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a reachable defect a sibling change exposes**. `reach:` `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.deleteItem`, read from source at PR #23290's head (#23165's fix). Dev report `6148282605` on #23165, out-of-scope finding 3. The dev noted it as an Acceptance note with no carrier, and this card is its carrier. Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/client` is `domain:cli`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at #23165's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens when PR #23290 lands

- REST's `DELETE /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME` gains `?package=`, the same address grammar as the save door. A package-less delete of a name two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming them, and naming the package is the remedy.
- `meta.deleteItem` in `@objectstack/client` sends no package option, so an SDK caller (an agent, the CLI, an app) has no way to follow the 409's remedy.
- This is the same class as #11391 (closed), where `meta.saveItem` sent no query string, so the `?force=true` a 409 prescribed was unreachable through the SDK.

## Wanted

- `meta.deleteItem` takes an optional package and sends it as `?package=`, as the save path already does for its package.
- Pins: a delete naming a package sends it, and a delete naming none sends nothing.

Order: after PR #23290 lands. The console's reset is objectstack-ai/objectui#12300's half, and that card gets its own pointer at #23165's landing.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `client SDK meta.deleteItem package option delete metadata item package query parameter` → 5 hits. #11391 is the closed sibling on `saveItem`, and #11679 (closed) covered the request schema's members. None is this.

Dedupe words: meta.deleteItem package option; SDK delete package query; client deleteItem 409 remedy unreachable.
